title: Taiwan's Export Orders Hit a Record US$123.8 Billion on AI Demand
summaryZh: AI需求帶動，台灣10月外銷訂單創新高1238億美元。
summaryHi: AI की मांग से ताइवान के अक्टूबर निर्यात ऑर्डर रिकॉर्ड 123.82 अरब डॉलर पर पहुँचे।
summaryEs: Impulsados por la IA, los pedidos de exportación de Taiwán marcan un récord de 123.820 millones de dólares en octubre.
summaryJa: AI需要で台湾の10月輸出受注が過去最高の1238億ドルに。
summaryKo: AI 수요에 힘입어 대만 10월 수출 수주가 사상 최대 1,238억 달러 기록.
summaryEn: Taiwan's October export orders jumped 78.3% to a record US$123.82 billion, driven by AI demand.
paragraphs: Taiwan's export orders hit an all-time high in October as global demand for artificial intelligence hardware continued to surge, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced on Friday.

Orders climbed 78.3 percent year-on-year to 123.82 billion US dollars. It was the 21st consecutive month of annual growth and the sharpest year-on-year increase on record. Orders for the first ten months reached 943.02 billion dollars, up 58.6 percent.

Information and communication products led the way, with orders more than doubling to 46.77 billion dollars, while electronic products jumped 89.8 percent to 53.91 billion dollars. In both categories, the United States accounted for most of the growth. Even basic metals and machinery rose, boosted by copper materials for AI servers and new chip factories.

Department of Statistics director Huang Wei-chieh said October beat expectations, and smartphone orders were also stronger than forecast. He cautioned, though, that low-priced Chinese exports remain a challenge for some Taiwanese manufacturers.

The ministry predicts November orders of up to 118.7 billion dollars and says a full-year total above 1.1 trillion dollars is highly likely. The upbeat figures contrasted with a turbulent week on the stock market, where worries about the AI industry triggered heavy selling.
Taiwan sells many things to other countries. Companies around the world send orders to Taiwan's factories. In October, these orders were bigger than ever before.
The orders were worth 123.82 billion US dollars. That is 78.3 percent more than in October last year. Orders have grown every month for 21 months.
Most of the new orders came from the United States. Buyers want computer parts and phones for AI, or artificial intelligence. Orders for computer and phone products more than doubled.
A government official, Huang Wei-chieh, was happy with the numbers. But he said cheap goods from China are a problem for some Taiwanese factories.
The government thinks orders for this year will be more than 1.1 trillion US dollars. This good news came in a week when Taiwan's stock market fell a lot.

paragraphs: Taiwan received a record amount of export orders in October, the Ministry of Economic Affairs said on Friday. Export orders show how much foreign buyers plan to purchase from Taiwanese companies.
October's orders reached 123.82 billion US dollars, up 78.3 percent from a year earlier. It was the 21st month in a row of growth and the biggest yearly rise ever recorded.

Demand for artificial intelligence was the main reason. Orders for information and communication products more than doubled to 46.77 billion dollars, and orders for electronic products rose almost 90 percent. Most of this growth came from the United States.
Huang Wei-chieh, a statistics official, said the results were better than expected. However, he warned that cheap exports from China are still putting pressure on some local manufacturers.
For the first ten months, orders totalled 943.02 billion dollars. The ministry expects November to stay strong and says yearly orders above 1.1 trillion dollars are very likely.

paragraphs: Taiwan's export orders soared to an unprecedented level in October, underlining how deeply the island's manufacturers are embedded in the global boom in artificial intelligence, according to figures released by the Ministry of Economic Affairs on Friday.

Orders surged 78.3 percent year-on-year to 123.82 billion US dollars, extending a run of annual growth to 21 consecutive months and marking the steepest year-on-year gain since records began. Cumulative orders for January to October stood at 943.02 billion dollars, a 58.6 percent rise.

The driving force was unmistakable. Orders for information and communication products more than doubled to 46.77 billion dollars, while those for electronic products climbed 89.8 percent to 53.91 billion dollars, with American clients responsible for the bulk of the expansion. The ripple effects reached basic metals and machinery, which benefited from demand for copper foil used in AI servers and from ongoing semiconductor capacity expansion.

Huang Wei-chieh, director of the ministry's statistics department, acknowledged that the results had exceeded expectations, but noted that aggressively priced Chinese goods continue to squeeze certain domestic producers.

Looking ahead, the ministry forecasts November orders of between 115 and 118.7 billion dollars and considers an annual total above 1.1 trillion dollars highly likely. The robust data offered some reassurance in a week when the Taiex suffered a record weekly loss amid jitters over the sustainability of AI spending.
sentZh: 根據經濟部週五公布的數據，台灣十月外銷訂單飆升至前所未有的水準，凸顯台灣製造商與全球人工智慧熱潮的連結有多深。
訂單年增78.3%至1,238.2億美元，使年增紀錄延長到連續21個月，並創下有紀錄以來最大的年增幅。
一月至十月的累計訂單為9,430.2億美元，成長58.6%。
推動力量顯而易見。
資訊與通信產品訂單增加一倍以上至467.7億美元，電子產品訂單則攀升89.8%至539.1億美元，其中大部分擴張來自美國客戶。
連鎖效應也擴及基本金屬和機械，它們受惠於AI伺服器所用銅箔的需求，以及持續進行的半導體產能擴充。
經濟部統計處處長黃偉傑承認結果超出預期，但也指出，以低價強攻的中國商品持續擠壓部分國內生產者。
展望未來，經濟部預估十一月訂單介於1,150億至1,187億美元，並認為全年總額超過1.1兆美元的可能性很高。
在台股因市場擔心AI支出能否持續而創下單週最大跌幅的這一週，這些強勁的數據帶來了些許安心。

paragraphs: Taiwan's export orders reached a record high in October, providing compelling evidence of the island's pivotal role in the global artificial intelligence supply chain. The Ministry of Economic Affairs reported on Friday that orders had grown faster than at any point since official records began.

Orders rose by 78.3 percent compared with the same month last year, reaching 123.82 billion US dollars. This represented the 21st consecutive month of year-on-year growth. Over the first ten months of the year, orders amounted to 943.02 billion dollars, an increase of 58.6 percent.

The surge was concentrated in technology. Orders for information and communication products more than doubled to 46.77 billion dollars, and those for electronic products grew by 89.8 percent, with the United States generating the majority of this growth. Notably, more traditional sectors also benefited: basic metals rose by 22 percent and machinery by 36.3 percent, reflecting demand for AI server components and the expansion of chip production.

Nevertheless, officials sounded a note of caution. Huang Wei-chieh, who heads the ministry's statistics department, observed that competition from inexpensive Chinese exports continues to put considerable pressure on some local manufacturers.

The ministry anticipates that annual orders will very probably exceed 1.1 trillion dollars. However, the encouraging figures coincided with a volatile week for investors, as concerns about whether AI investment can be sustained led to a sharp sell-off on the Taiwan stock market.
sentZh: 台灣十月外銷訂單創下歷史新高，有力證明台灣在全球人工智慧供應鏈中的關鍵角色。
經濟部週五表示，訂單成長速度是官方有紀錄以來最快的。
訂單比去年同月增加78.3%，達到1,238.2億美元。
這代表連續第21個月年增。
今年前十個月，訂單總計9,430.2億美元，成長58.6%。
這波暴增集中在科技領域。
資訊與通信產品訂單增加一倍以上至467.7億美元，電子產品成長89.8%，其中大部分成長來自美國。
值得注意的是，較傳統的產業也受惠：基本金屬成長22%，機械成長36.3%，反映出對AI伺服器零組件的需求和晶片生產的擴張。
儘管如此，官員也提出警告。
經濟部統計處處長黃偉傑指出，來自廉價中國出口品的競爭持續對部分本地製造商造成相當大的壓力。
經濟部預期全年訂單很可能超過1.1兆美元。
然而，這些令人鼓舞的數字恰逢投資人經歷動盪的一週，對AI投資能否持續的擔憂導致台灣股市大幅拋售。

noted.ex: She noted that prices had risen.

november.en: the eleventh month of the year

observed.en: seen; or said as a comment
observed.ex: A rare bird was observed near the lake.

offered.ex: Many families offer rooms to students.

official.ex: We are waiting for an official answer.

officials.en: people with important jobs in government
officials.ex: City officials met to discuss the plan.

on.ex: He accepted the award on behalf of the team.

orders.en: requests from customers to buy goods
orders.ex: The factory received many new orders.

over.ex: Over half of the students passed.

parts.ex: Some parts of the film were boring.

percent.ex: Ten percent of the class was absent.

phones.ex: Keep your phones charged in a storm.

pivotal.en: very important for what happens next
pivotal.ex: This is a pivotal moment for the team.

example.en: Taiwan plays a pivotal role in making advanced chips.
example.zh: 台灣在製造先進晶片上扮演關鍵角色。

note.usage: 常見 play a pivotal role in sth。

noteHi.exampleTr: उन्नत चिप बनाने में ताइवान की निर्णायक भूमिका है।
noteHi.usage: play a pivotal role in sth आम प्रयोग है।

noteEs.exampleTr: Taiwán desempeña un papel crucial en la fabricación de chips avanzados.
noteEs.usage: Se usa play a pivotal role in algo.

noteJa.exampleTr: 台湾は先端半導体の製造で極めて重要な役割を果たしている。
noteJa.meaning: 極めて重要な；中心的な。
noteJa.usage: play a pivotal role in ～ の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 대만은 첨단 칩 제조에서 중추적인 역할을 한다.
noteKo.usage: play a pivotal role in ~ 형태가 흔하다.

plan.en: a set of ideas for doing something
plan.ex: We have a plan for next year.

point.ex: Prices are at their lowest point.

predicts.en: says what will happen in the future
predicts.ex: The bank predicts slower growth next year.

priced.ex: The new phones are aggressively priced.

producers.en: people or companies who make films and TV shows
producers.ex: The producers hope to start filming in spring.

production.en: the making of films or TV programmes
production.ex: Production of the series begins in May.

providing.ex: The charity is providing food to families.

purchase.ex: The purchase of the land was finally agreed.

put.ex: The shop put up its prices again.

putting.zh: 施加（putting pressure on：施加壓力）
putting.ex: High costs are putting pressure on small firms.

reached.ex: The news reached us late at night.

reason.ex: There is no reason to worry.

reassurance.ja: 安心感；安心させるもの
reassurance.en: something that makes people feel less worried
reassurance.ex: The good news gave investors some reassurance.

record.en: past achievements; or the highest ever
record.ex: The firm has a good safety record.

recorded.en: filmed; or written down as a number
recorded.ex: It was the biggest rise ever recorded.

reflecting.en: showing or being a sign of something
reflecting.ex: Sales rose, reflecting greater demand for electric cars.

remain.ex: The shops remain closed on Sundays.

reported.ex: The radio reported a big fire downtown.

represented.ex: The figure represented a big rise.

responsible.en: having a duty to deal with
responsible.ex: Who is responsible for road safety?

results.ex: The test results came out today.

ripple.ex: The news rippled through the small town.

example.en: The factory closure had a ripple effect on local shops.
example.zh: 工廠關閉對當地商店產生連鎖效應。

note.usage: 常見 ripple effect(s) on/through sth。

noteEn.meaning: a spreading effect caused by one event.

noteHi.exampleTr: कारखाना बंद होने का स्थानीय दुकानों पर श्रृंखलाबद्ध असर पड़ा।
noteHi.usage: ripple effect on sth आम प्रयोग है।

noteEs.exampleTr: El cierre de la fábrica tuvo un efecto dominó en las tiendas locales.
noteEs.usage: Se usa ripple effect on algo.

noteJa.exampleTr: 工場閉鎖は地元商店に波及効果をもたらした。
noteJa.usage: ripple effect on ～ の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 공장 폐쇄는 지역 상점에 파급 효과를 미쳤다.

rise.ex: There was a sharp rise in prices.

robust.ex: The firm gave a robust reply to the claims.

example.en: The economy showed robust growth last year.
example.zh: 去年經濟呈現強勁成長。

noteHi.exampleTr: पिछले साल अर्थव्यवस्था में मज़बूत वृद्धि हुई।

noteEs.exampleTr: La economía mostró un crecimiento sólido el año pasado.

noteJa.exampleTr: 昨年、経済は力強い成長を見せた。

role.ex: He has a key role in the team.

row.ex: There was a row over pay.

run.en: a period in which something keeps happening
run.ex: The team extended its winning run.

same.ex: We sat in the same seats.

says.ex: The report says costs will rise.

sell-off.en: a time when many people sell shares quickly
sell-off.ex: The sell-off began in New York.

selling.ex: The shop started selling coffee last year.

sells.en: gives something in exchange for money

semiconductor.en: material used to make computer chips
semiconductor.ex: Taiwan has a large semiconductor industry.

send.en: to make a message go to someone
send.ex: Please send me the file today.

server.en: a powerful computer that stores data for a network
server.ex: The company bought new servers for AI.

servers.en: powerful computers that store data for a network
servers.ex: Data centres are full of servers.

sharp.ex: There was a sharp rise in prices.

sharpest.ex: It was the sharpest fall in ten years.

show.ex: The figures show a big rise.

since.en: from a past time until now

smartphone.en: a mobile phone that works like a small computer
smartphone.ex: She checks the news on her smartphone.

soared.en: rose very quickly to a high level
soared.ex: House prices soared after the new station opened.

some.en: a number of, but not all
some.ex: Some parents may still hesitate to use the plan.

sounded.zh: 發出（sound a note of caution：提出警告）
sounded.ex: The minister sounded a note of caution.

squeeze.en: to put pressure on; make it hard to make money

states.ja: 州（United States：アメリカ合衆国）
states.en: parts of a country (United States = the USA)
states.ex: Most orders came from the United States.

statistics.en: numbers that give facts about something
statistics.ex: Statistics show more people cycle to work.

steepest.en: the biggest and fastest (of a rise or fall)
steepest.ex: It was the steepest rise in house prices this year.

still.ex: It was cold. Still, we went swimming.

stock.en: goods a business has ready to sell
stock.ex: The shop has little stock left.

stood.en: was at a certain level or number

strong.ex: A strong current pulled the boat away.

stronger.ex: The wind got stronger after dark.

supply.ex: The supply of fresh water is limited.

surge.ex: There was a surge in online shopping this month.

example.en: There was a surge in demand for laptops.

note.usage: 常見 a surge in demand；surge to a record。

noteEn.meaning: a sudden, large increase; to increase suddenly.

noteHi.exampleTr: लैपटॉप की मांग में अचानक उछाल आया।
noteHi.usage: a surge in demand आम प्रयोग है।

noteEs.exampleTr: Hubo un aumento repentino de la demanda de portátiles.
noteEs.usage: Se usa a surge in demand.

noteJa.exampleTr: ノートPCの需要が急増した。
noteJa.usage: a surge in demand の形が多い。

noteKo.usage: a surge in demand 형태가 흔하다.

sustainability.en: the ability to continue at the same level
sustainability.ex: Investors worry about the sustainability of high spending.

example.en: Investors question the sustainability of high AI spending.
example.zh: 投資人質疑高額AI支出的可持續性。

note.usage: 常見 the sustainability of sth；environmental sustainability。

noteEn.meaning: the ability to continue over a long time.

noteHi.exampleTr: निवेशक भारी AI खर्च की स्थिरता पर सवाल उठाते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: स्थिरता; लंबे समय तक चल पाने की क्षमता।
noteHi.usage: the sustainability of sth आम प्रयोग है।

noteEs.exampleTr: Los inversores dudan de la sostenibilidad del alto gasto en IA.
noteEs.usage: Se usa the sustainability of algo.

noteJa.exampleTr: 投資家は巨額のAI支出の持続可能性を疑問視している。
noteJa.usage: the sustainability of ～ の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 투자자들은 막대한 AI 지출의 지속 가능성에 의문을 제기한다.

sustained.ex: The city saw a sustained rise in tourism.

taiwan.en: an island country in East Asia

technology.en: machines and science used in practice

things.ex: Put your things in the bag.

turbulent.en: moving in a strong, uneven, violent way
turbulent.ex: The plane flew through turbulent air.

underlining.en: showing clearly that something is important
underlining.ex: The data are underlining the need for change.

united.ex: The team stayed united after the defeat.

example.en: Demand for AI chips has reached an unprecedented level.
example.zh: AI晶片的需求已達到前所未有的水準。

note.meaning: 前所未有的；史無前例的。
note.usage: 常見 unprecedented level/scale/growth；at an unprecedented rate。

noteHi.exampleTr: AI चिप्स की मांग अभूतपूर्व स्तर पर पहुँच गई है।

noteEs.exampleTr: La demanda de chips de IA ha alcanzado un nivel sin precedentes.

noteJa.exampleTr: AIチップの需要は前例のない水準に達した。

noteKo.exampleTr: AI 칩 수요가 전례 없는 수준에 이르렀다.

up.ex: Prices went up again this month.

upbeat.ex: The mood at the meeting was upbeat.

used.en: did something with a tool or product
used.ex: We used a map to find the hotel.

want.en: to wish to have or do

way.zh: 方式；道路（lead the way：領先）
way.ja: 道；（lead the way）先頭に立つ
way.en: a road or method; lead the way = be in front
way.ex: Tech stocks led the way today.

week.ex: I go swimming twice a week.

wei-chieh.en: part of the name Huang Wei-chieh, a statistics official

were.ex: The shops were closed on Sunday.

where.ex: This is the café where we first met.

whether.en: used to express a choice (if or not)

which.en: used to add information about a thing

who.en: used to add information about a person

worries.en: feelings that something bad may happen
worries.ex: Parents have worries about screen time.

year-on-year.en: compared with the same time last year
year-on-year.ex: Sales showed a year-on-year rise of 5 per cent.
